scenicChapters.title: Trans-Flores Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 29 km this is Trans-Flores Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

road-trans-flores-highway.story: A 890 km round trip from Labuan Bajo - roughly 14 h 50 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ruteng, Bajawa, Ende and Moni. The highest point is about 900 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 108 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-andermatt-mont.story: A 241 km one-way ride from near Andermatt, about 3 h 55 of riding. On the way it passes Furka Pass and Tasch for Zermatt. The highest point is about 2,650 m. Furka Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
